title: Sable and the Deadline
author: Mara Halloran
blurb: Casper Okafor, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
